source_span.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-weightings (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1721-1734

the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: For the first part choose the diagram of the weighting definition, transport along the base-change compatibility lemma so it suffices to show the integral of the restricted weighting over the etale cover is locally constant, compute that integral as a fibre sum reducing to the coefficient of the target point in the pushforward of the restricted relative zero-cycle, and conclude local constancy by the smoothness lemma; for the second part define the family of zero-cycles on fibres by dividing the weighting values by the inseparable degrees, choose a sufficiently divisible integer using universal boundedness of the fibres of a quasi-compact locally quasi-finite morphism, note the construction and the base-change compatibility lemma never used the relative-cycle property so the constructed family has weighting n times w after any base change while base changes of weightings are weightings, reduce to the spectrum of a discrete valuation ring, form the relative zero-cycle beta with the same generic fibre and closed fibre equal to the specialization, observe the difference of its weighting and n times w is a weighting vanishing over the generic point, and conclude by the specialization lemma for weightings that it is identically zero, whence the constructed family equals beta; the final part follows from the same construction since inseparable degrees of finite field extensions are powers of the characteristic (source lines 1736-1798)
